description: Predict sees available_bytes around 1.79GB versus required_bytes around 5.67GB and always falls back to streaming even though torch has a large reusable reserved pool from fit.
expected: After fit on the same CUDA device, predict gpu_resident activation should account for reclaimable torch reserved memory and should not misclassify reusable reserved pool as unavailable. Loud fallback must still happen when driver_free + reclaimable remains below required bytes.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
